title: Highlights of Shanghai | A Journey Through Culture & Cityscapes
highlights: Explore Shanghai’s dynamic mix of tradition and modernity, from historic temples to futuristic skyscrapers, all set against its vibrant skyline and rich cultural heritage.
Soar to new heights at the Oriental Pearl Tower, where breathtaking panoramic views showcase Shanghai’s skyline and the Huangpu River.
Take a Huangpu River Cruise, where you’ll glide past iconic landmarks, from the dazzling skyscrapers of Pudong to the historic Bund.
Visit Disneyland, where beautiful castles, thrilling rides, and beloved characters create a truly unforgettable experience.
Discover Shanghai Zoo with over 6,000 animals from around the world, including the rare giant panda and South China Tigers.
inclusions: Transfer from Shanghai Pudong International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
4 nights stay in Shanghai with breakfast
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Shanghai Pudong International Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Carry a valid ID proof at all times.
The official currency is the Renminbi (RMB). Carry both cash and a credit card, as not all places accept cards.
Mandarin is the official language. English is not widely spoken, so learning basic phrases or using translation apps can be helpful.
Respect local customs, including bowing slightly when greeting and removing shoes in some homes or temples.
Tipping is not customary in China but may be appreciated in some high-end establishments.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Shanghai | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Shanghai! Upon arrival at Shanghai Pudong International Airport, get transferred to your hotel. Check-in, and enjoy some free time to explore the city at your own pace. You can take a walk along the iconic Bund to admire stunning river views or explore the rich heritage at the Shanghai Museum. For a fun experience, you can shop at Nanjing Road, one of the world’s busiest shopping streets. Afterward, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Half-Day Shanghai City Tour | Visit to Oriental Pearl Tower | Hungpu River Cruise Experience
days.desc: Today, get driven to explore the heart of Shanghai’s cultural & architectural wonders. Begin at the Jade Buddha Temple, housing exquisite jade statues. Next, wander through Yu Garden, an example of traditional Chinese landscaping with ponds & pavilions. Visit the Longhua Temple, the oldest in the city, renowned for its towering pagoda & Buddhist artifacts. Conclude with sweeping views from the Oriental Pearl Tower & a scenic Huangpu River cruise, where modern skyscrapers meet historic landmarks.

days.title: Visit Disneyland | Meet your favorite Disney Characters
days.desc: Today, head to Disneyland and step into a world of magic at Shanghai Disneyland, China’s first Disney park and the largest in Asia. Begin your adventure on thrilling rides like TRON Lightcycle Power Run, a futuristic high-speed coaster. Wander through Enchanted Storybook Castle, the tallest Disney castle, and explore themed lands filled with beloved characters. Enjoy live performances, and end the day with the Ignite the Dream fireworks show, where fantasy and technology create Disney magic.

days.title: Full Day at Shanghai Zoo
days.desc: Today, visit Shanghai Zoo, home to over 6,000 animals, including giant pandas and rare golden monkeys. Walk through green spaces and see South China tigers and red-crowned cranes up close. The zoo also focuses on conservation, creating natural habitats for its animals. You can also explore different zones featuring reptiles and Asian elephants. Enjoy interactive exhibits, feeding sessions, and a peaceful escape from the city’s hustle. Afterward, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Post check out from your hotel, get driven to the airport for your flight back home. This marks the end of your Shanghai trip.
